note: NECO Government round 4 (Round 26 top-up): legitimacy, absolute sovereignty, authority vs power, political socialisation; unwritten and flexible constitutions, controls on delegated legislation, rigidity; fiscal centralisation problem, exclusive list, federalism definition, residuary powers; legislature's lawmaking, checks and balances, rule of law, judicial security of tenure; Clifford 1922 elective principle, Richards 1946 regionalism, Macpherson 1951 central legislature, Lyttleton 1954 federal principle; prime minister as head of government, presidential separation, unitarism, military suspension of constitutions; party functions, two-party system, franchise, pressure-group methods, INEC, e-voting; civil-service permanence and anonymity, local government functions, Public Complaints Commission; ECOWAS and OPEC aims; politicised census. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-3, WAEC Government (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
